race.description: Community Bank Narrandera & District Mdn Hcp
race.comment: SENSESATIONAL STAR (12) never looked likely last start at Albury when getting a long way back again but he did warm nicely late. Peaking now fourth-up and if they can settle closer she will take a power of stopping. I'VE FORGOTTEN (7) finished 1.4 lengths from the winner in fourth last start over 1175m at Albury, an improvement on his fifth on debut at this track the run before. Finds a nice race to go even better,. SHARP REMARK (6) turned in a much better run at her second appearance last time out when finishing third over this trip at Wangaratta. Has further upside and looks ready to break through. CLASSIC CRACKER (8) gave away a big start at the top of the straight last start and never really got going, failing to replicate the strong turn of foot she showed fresh. Expect her to drift back again from the draw and be saved for the final shot at them. DEMANDA (3) was a sharp improver third-up when missing the bob at Gundagai. Can build off that and is in the mix.
